transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, I've been having some trouble with eating. It's just... once I start, it's like I can't stop. Especially if I'm alone in the kitchen. It feels like I'm not even in control anymore. I'll be telling myself to just put the food away, but I just... can't make myself do it. It's kind of scary.
Do you usually feel guilty or ashamed after one of these eating episodes?

Yes. I do. Um... I feel awful about myself, really. I end up wasting food that I meant to share, and... well, I just feel like I'm too old to be acting this way. I usually just sit there ashamed. I always promise myself it won't happen again.
How often do these episodes of uncontrollable eating happen?
Um... I guess... looking back at my kitchen calendar, and the weeks I go to the food bank... it's most weeks. Usually once or twice. It's been happening for many months now.
Do you ever try to make up for these episodes of eating by doing something to counteract the calories?
Um... no. I don't do anything like that. I just... sit with it, I guess.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after one of these eating episodes?
No. Um... I don't ever do that.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't really weigh myself or anything. I think it's mostly stayed about the same.
During these episodes, do you feel like you're eating a much larger amount of food than most people would eat under similar circumstances?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Sometimes when I get home after a shift at the food bank, or... if I was baking for an event at the senior center... I'll eat a full plate of leftovers. And then... I'll just keep going. I'll have slices of banana bread, and chips, and cheese... just whatever cookies are in the tin. Afterward, I... I realize it was way more than I would ever serve to someone else. So, yes.
Do you ever eat large amounts of food in a short period of time without feeling like you've lost control?
Um... no. I don't think so. If I'm eating that much, it's... it's usually just like I described. I don't really feel like I can stop it.
Do you usually find yourself eating very quickly during these episodes where you feel like you can't stop?

Um... yeah. I guess I do. Sometimes I... I just catch myself eating so fast. I barely even taste the casserole, or... the muffins I made. I'll just be standing at the kitchen counter, taking bite after bite. Like I'm in some big hurry... even though I don't have anywhere to be.
Do you usually feel anxious or stressed right before one of these episodes where you can't stop eating?
Um... I don't know. I guess I haven't really thought about it.
Do you usually feel anxious or stressed right before one of these episodes where you can't stop eating?
Um... like I said, I'm not really sure. I haven't paid much attention to how I'm feeling right before. I just... find myself doing it.
Do you think your episodes of uncontrollable eating are usually triggered by feelings of sadness, anger, or other strong emotions?
I don't really know. Um... I guess I just haven't noticed if I'm sad or mad or anything. It just sort of... happens.
Do you think your episodes of uncontrollable eating are usually triggered by feelings of sadness, anger, or other strong emotions?
I... I really don't know what else to tell you. Like I just said, I don't really focus on my feelings like that. I just haven't noticed.
Do you often think very critically about yourself after these episodes of eating?

Yeah, I do. Um... afterward, I just feel awful about myself. I mean, I sit there and... I think about how I've wasted food that I was supposed to share with my family. And... I just feel like I'm too old to be acting this way. It's just... shameful. I always promise myself it won't happen again.
Do you think your episodes of uncontrollable eating are usually triggered by boredom?
I don't... I mean, not really. I'm usually busy enough around the house. I don't think it's just because I'm bored.
Do you think the guilt you feel after these episodes is because of the amount of food you eat or because of something else?
I guess... I don't really know. I just feel bad about it all. I haven't really thought about exactly why.
Do you think your episodes of uncontrollable eating happen when you're feeling emotional?
I'm not... I don't really know. I guess I haven't really paid attention to that. I don't really think about my feelings much before it happens... it just sort of does.
Do you think your episodes of uncontrollable eating happen when you're feeling upset or overwhelmed?

I'm not really sure. Like I said, I don't... I don't really focus on that kind of thing. Sometimes things are a bit much around the house, I guess, but I couldn't say if that's what causes it. I just haven't really noticed a connection.
Do you ever avoid eating with other people because you're embarrassed about how you eat?
Not really. I mean... I don't really eat out much anyway. I usually just eat at home. So, no, I wouldn't say I avoid people on purpose.
Do you think your episodes of uncontrollable eating are usually triggered by feeling upset?
I... I think I just answered that. I really don't know. Like I said, I don't sit around analyzing if I'm upset or not before it happens. I just haven't noticed.
